title: Toolbar Spacing Unified System
description: Redesign the Sketchpad toolbar layout system to unify spacing and sizing across all component types (toggles, dropdowns, commands, buttons) using design tokens
summary: Added CSS normalization rules in globals.css that strip inner group borders (border-width:0) and force height inheritance (height:100%) on toggle-group, button-group, toggle-group-item, and button-group-item when inside toolbar-zone. This makes ToolbarZone the single source of truth for element height via --toolbar-item-height token. All toolbar elements (Toggle, Button, ActionGroup) now render at identical heights regardless of component family. Documented the mechanism in sketchpad README specs. All 11 JS tests pass.

interactions.prompt: The toolbar spacing unification is incomplete. Toggle actions (e.g. filter-settings Designs toggle) still render with different sizes than command buttons (e.g. Create Designs). Need to create a mechanism that unifies ALL toolbar element sizes without hardcoding, ensuring toggles, dropdowns, and commands get consistent spacing.
